posts.text: Turnaround confirmed and accelerating What was signal in Q1 (May) is now proof in Q2 (August): Two quarters, not one : margin now 15.8% → 18.2% quarter-on-quarter, not a one-off All-round : Carbon margin 18.5% H1, Advanced Materials margin recovered from 4.3% (FY25) to 10.3% - the specialty chemicals side is finally working, not just Carbon Volumes AND price : Carbon volumes 659kt (Q1), Adv Mat volumes up decisively - this is real demand, not just pricing Global tailwinds intact - Middle East aluminum supply disruption + LME strength + BAM feedstock competition all supporting CPC pricing
